data.disagreement_analysis: The 'inconclusive' verdicts from qwen3 and openrouter/free were caused by tool errors (an HTTP 400 error on the LICENSE file and a failure to parse the model's response for the PKGBUILD, respectively). coverage_issues: qwen3 failed to audit the LICENSE file due to an API error (HTTP 400).
openrouter/free failed to parse the PKGBUILD audit response, resulting in an inconclusive status for the most critical file.
learnings: The audit tool should handle partial file audit failures gracefully. An API error on a non-executable file like LICENSE should not force the entire package verdict to 'inconclusive' if the PKGBUILD and other critical files are verified safe.

The response parser for openrouter/free models needs to be more robust to handle slight deviations in the expected XML format (e.g., when the model outputs 'User Safety: safe' instead of the structured tags).
